يستفتوا (form X)
# يَسْتَفْتُوا (yastaftū) /jas.taf.tuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
# يُسْتَفْتَوْا (yustaftaw) /jus.taf.taw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
